name: Projects ID
source: Lilan, an amnesiac girl rescued by a handsome and caring man; Blaine. While she starts her life at Blaine's house, she meets a robot programmed to protect her from danger;  Siegfried, Blaine's genius friend Dio, a troublesome runaway politician Terha and town's robot doctor Nikolai... While she tries to remember her past she gets close to them... What will await her, who is she??
translation: 莉蘭是一名失憶少女，被英俊體貼的布萊恩救下。她在布萊恩家開始生活後，遇見了程式設定為保護她的機器人齊格菲、布萊恩的天才朋友迪奧、惹麻煩的逃亡政治家特爾哈，以及鎮上的機器人醫生尼古拉。她努力回憶過去，同時逐漸與他們親近……等待她的命運是什麼？她究竟是誰？
